en.name: Blur Text Animation
en.title: Blur Text Animation: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: Words resolve from heavy blur one at a time, blur out, and a tagline sharpens into a product mark. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
howto: Give every word or letter the same entrance: start at 52px blur, scale 1.12 and opacity 0, with up to 9px of sideways drift and 12–26px below, then ease to 0px blur and scale 1 over 1.1s with power3.out while opacity rises over half that time with power1.out. Stagger the units: 0.28s between words and 0.035s between letters on the 150px hero line, 0.2s between words on the 168px second line. A line leaves by the reverse move word by word (46px blur, scale 1.07, 14px up, power2.in over 0.7s, 0.1s apart), and the next line starts arriving about 0.4s before it has finished.

Put a product screen behind the text and let it carry the idea. A 1700x960 editor sits at 60% opacity under a dark veil, starts at 9px blur and sharpens over 5.6–6.9s while the third line reads We bring it into focus. At 7.55s the 184px tagline Write clearly. resolves from 60px blur letter by letter (0.3s between words, 0.04s between letters), the screen dims to 13%, and at 8.7s the tagline rises 104px as a 108px mark and the wordmark resolve under it.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the editor, the text units and the lockup. Use one accent such as amber #ffb15c on the last word of the tagline and the mark, keep Inter 700 with -0.035em letter-spacing, and take drift values from a seeded generator. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.
faq: What is a blur text animation?

A blur text animation shows text that starts heavily blurred and invisible and sharpens into focus, usually one word or letter at a time. A staggered start for each unit makes the line read in sequence, and the same blur applied in reverse makes a line leave.
How large should the blur be?

Large enough that a word loses its letter shapes but keeps its colour and width, which is about 46–60px of blur on 150–184px type. Add a small scale change (1.12 down to 1.0) and a few pixels of drift so the blur looks like focus pulling.

zh.name: 模糊文字动画
zh.title: 模糊文字动画：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 文字逐词从重度模糊中变清楚，再逐词虚化消失，最后标语变清楚、产品标志落下。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个模糊文字动画。
howto: 每个词或每个字用同一个进场动作：从 52px 模糊、缩放 1.12、透明度 0 开始，侧向最多漂 9px、从下方 12–26px 升起，用 1.1s、power3.out 变到 0px 模糊、缩放 1，透明度用 power1.out 在一半时长内升到 1。单元之间错开：150px 的主视觉行词间隔 0.28s、字间隔 0.035s，168px 的第 2 行词间隔 0.2s。一行字用反向动作逐词离开（46px 模糊、缩放 1.07、上移 14px，power2.in 用时 0.7s，间隔 0.1s），下一行在它虚化完之前约 0.4s 就开始进场。

文字背后放一个产品界面，让它也参与表达。1700x960 的编辑器以 60% 透明度压在暗罩下，起始带 9px 模糊，在 5.6–6.9s 变清楚，此时第 3 行正好是 We bring it into focus.。7.55s 184px 的标语 Write clearly. 从 60px 模糊逐字变清楚（词间隔 0.3s，字间隔 0.04s），界面压暗到 13%，8.7s 标语上移 104px，108px 的标志和字标在它下面变清楚。

点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会做出编辑器、文字单元和落款。只用一个强调色，比如琥珀 #ffb15c，用在标语最后一个词和标志上，字体保持 Inter 700、字距 −0.035em，漂移量取自带种子的随机数。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。
faq: 模糊文字动画让文字从重度模糊、几乎看不见的状态变清楚，通常一个词或一个字一个字地来。每个单元错开起始时间，一行字就按顺序被读到；把同样的模糊反过来用，一行字就离开画面。
大到词失去笔画形状、但还留着颜色和宽度，在 150–184px 的字上大约是 46–60px 的模糊。再加一点缩放（1.12 到 1.0）和几 px 的漂移，看上去才像对焦。
